info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout Listing API allows developers to retrieve a comprehensive list of checkouts within an e-commerce cart. This operation serves as a vital resource for applications managing shopping experiences, enabling businesses to track user checkouts efficiently. Suitable for e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, this API provides essential insights into customer transactions, supporting analytics and decision-making processes. Developers can leverage this feature to enhance user experience and optimize sales strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve checkout information for the cart
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current checkout information related to the items in your cart, including total cost, shipping options, and applicable discounts.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended to initiate the checkout process for the items in the user's cart. It is expected to contain the necessary details for processing the checkout, such as user authentication information and cart item details.

200.description: Successful checkout request, returning current cart status.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: Represents the request body in JSON format for the checkout operation in the cart service. This schema expects a string representation of the data to be processed.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the checkout operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the checkout operation.

state.description: The current state of the checkout process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the checkout operation containing the status and details of the checkout process.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the checkout.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the checkout was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the checkout was completed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the creation and status of the checkout operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the duration of time, in milliseconds, that the processing took to complete the checkout operation.
